issues.description: The problem statement (UML) declares acceptSupplyDelivery as a public method (+acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int): void), but the solution implements it without an access modifier (package-private). This visibility mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the intended API and may cause tests or external code expecting a public method to fail to compile or access the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's acceptSupplyDelivery method to be public static (public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)) so its visibility matches the UML/specification and the intended public API.
